# Theseus

> > Theseus is the national repository for Finnish Universities of Applied Sciences (UAS) theses and publications, managed by Arene ry.

Theseus provides open access to academic theses (opinnäytetyöt) and research publications from all Finnish ammattikorkeakoulu institutions. The platform serves as a centralized digital archive for sharing knowledge produced by students and researchers across the Finnish UAS network.

## Key Topics

- Ammattikorkeakoulu (Universities of Applied Sciences)
- Opinnäytetyöt (theses)
- Arene ry (Rectors' Conference of Finnish UAS)
- Open access repository
- Finnish higher education
- Academic publications
- Digital thesis archive
- Research dissemination
- Centria-ammattikorkeakoulu
- Haaga-Helia ammattikorkeakoulu
- LAB-ammattikorkeakoulu
- Karelia-ammattikorkeakoulu
- Jyväskylän ammattikorkeakoulu
- Verkkopalvelu (web service)

## Main Platform

- [Ammattikorkeakoulut - Theseus](https://www.theseus.fi): Homepage for Theseus repository of Finnish UAS theses and publications
